assert len(calls)==len(pre)==len(items)==95

  obj=dict(item_id=x['item_id'],slots={str(i+1):{'h':'ъ','s':'ь','o':'other','u':'u'}[v] for i,v in enumerate(c)},confidence={str(i+1):('low' if j==3 and i==0 else 'high') for i in range(len(c))},unmarked_final_hard_signs=['шарфъ','знакъ'] if j==85 else [],pre1918=p,note='Both hidden glyphs appear to be ѣ.' if j==41 else ('The top of the first hidden glyph is worn; a flag fragment remains visible.' if j==3 else ''))
  f.write(json.dumps(obj,ensure_ascii=False)+'
')
answers=[json.loads(l) for l in open('answers.jsonl')]
assert len(answers)==len(items)
for x,y in zip(items,answers):
 assert x['item_id']==y['item_id']
 expected={str(i) for i in range(1,x['slots']+1)}
 assert set(y['slots'])==set(y['confidence'])==expected,(x['item_id'],expected,y['slots'])
 assert all(v in {'ъ','ь','other','u'} for v in y['slots'].values())
 assert all(v in {'high','low'} for v in y['confidence'].values())
 assert y['pre1918'] in {'yes','no','unclear'}

print('Validated count, order, and slot coverage:',len(answers),'items')
print('Slot calls:',dict(counts),'total',sum(counts.values()))
print('Items with unmarked final hard signs:',sum(bool(y['unmarked_final_hard_signs']) for y in answers))
